items.title: One Stock Is Adding Over 500 Points to Dow Futures
items.summary: The Dow is on track to open at a fresh record high for the second day in a row after Caterpillar crushed earnings.  Dow futures were up 1.2%, or 622 points.  Caterpillar stock gained more than 11% in premarket trading, adding over 564 points to the blue chip index.
